CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_body_update BEFORE UPDATE ON private_content
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts r WHERE r.content_id=OLD.content_id)
 AND NEW.redacted_at IS NULL AND (OLD.redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_id IS NOT OLD.owner_id OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind
 OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR json_remove(NEW.content,'$.projected') IS NOT json_remove(OLD.content,'$.projected')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts r WHERE r.content_id=OLD.content_id AND r.state<>'active'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_body_immutable'); END

objects.name: memory_authored_image_receipt_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_receipt_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_authored_image_receipts
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts WHERE content_id=NEW.content_id OR event_id=NEW.event_id OR media_key=NEW.media_key)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private_content c JOIN event_private_payloads p ON p.owner_id=c.owner_id AND p.private_event_id=NEW.event_id
 JOIN events e ON e.event_id=p.private_event_id AND e.stream_id='creative:'||c.owner_id
 WHERE c.content_id=NEW.content_id AND c.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND c.kind='authored-memory-image' AND c.redacted_at IS NULL AND p.redacted_at IS NULL
 AND json_extract(p.private_json,'$.output_ref')=c.content_id AND json_extract(c.content,'$.key')=NEW.media_key
 AND e.type='GenerationCompleted' AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.memory_image_acceptance_version')=1 AND NEW.state='active')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_acceptance_required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_asset_consumer_content AFTER INSERT ON memory_derivation_consumer_contents
BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_derivation_asset_edges(source_kind,source_id,target_kind,target_id,owner_user_id,created_at,expires_at,state,retired_at)
 SELECT 'consumer',origin.origin_id,'content',NEW.content_id,origin.actor_user_id,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),MIN(origin.expires_at,content.expires_at),'active',NULL
 FROM memory_derivation_consumers origin JOIN private_content content ON content.content_id=NEW.content_id WHERE origin.origin_id=NEW.origin_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_asset_consumer_retired AFTER UPDATE OF state ON memory_derivation_consumers
WHEN NEW.state='retired' AND OLD.state='active'
BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_asset_edges SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
 WHERE state='active' AND (target_kind,target_id) IN(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(kind,id) AS(
   SELECT 'consumer',NEW.origin_id UNION SELECT edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants
    ON (edge.source_kind,edge.source_id)=(descendants.kind,descendants.id)) SELECT kind,id FROM descendants); END

BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_asset_edges SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))

objects.name: memory_derivation_asset_edges
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_asset_edges` (
	`source_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`source_id` text NOT NULL,
	`target_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`retired_at` text,
	PRIMARY KEY(`source_kind`, `source_id`, `target_kind`, `target_id`),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_asset_kinds" CHECK(source_kind IN('consumer','content','event') AND target_kind IN('content','event') AND (source_kind<>target_kind OR source_id<>target_id)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_asset_identity" CHECK(length(source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length(target_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length(owner_user_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_asset_state" CHECK((state='active' AND retired_at IS NULL) OR (state='retired' AND retired_at IS NOT NULL)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_asset_time" CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at AND length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND expires_at>created_at AND (retired_at IS NULL OR length(retired_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',retired_at) IS retired_at AND retired_at>=created_at))
)

BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_asset_edges SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
 WHERE state='active' AND (target_kind,target_id) IN(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(kind,id) AS(
   SELECT 'event',OLD.event_id UNION SELECT edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants

objects.name: memory_derivation_asset_event_inheritance
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_asset_event_inheritance AFTER INSERT ON event_private_payloads
WHEN NEW.redacted_at IS NULL AND json_valid(NEW.private_json)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE event_id=NEW.private_event_id AND type='AssistantReasoned'
   AND json_type(payload,'$.memory_origin_version')='integer' AND json_extract(payload,'$.memory_origin_version') IN(1,2,3))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE owner_user_id=NEW.owner_id AND target_kind='event')
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO memory_derivation_asset_edges(source_kind,source_id,target_kind,target_id,owner_user_id,created_at,expires_at,state,retired_at)
 SELECT 'event',parent.event_id,'event',NEW.private_event_id,NEW.owner_id,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),MIN(edge.expires_at),'active',NULL
 FROM events child JOIN events parent ON parent.stream_id=child.stream_id AND parent.sequence<child.sequence
 JOIN memory_derivation_asset_edges edge ON edge.target_kind='event' AND edge.target_id=parent.event_id
 WHERE child.event_id=NEW.private_event_id AND (parent.event_id=child.compensates_event_id OR parent.event_id=child.causation_id
  OR parent.event_id=json_extract(NEW.private_json,'$.source_event_id')) GROUP BY parent.event_id;
END

 WHERE state='active' AND (target_kind,target_id) IN(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(kind,id) AS(
   SELECT 'event',OLD.event_id UNION SELECT edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants

objects.name: memory_derivation_asset_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_asset_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_asset_edges
WHEN NEW.state<>'active' OR NEW.created_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') OR NEW.expires_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (source_kind,source_id,target_kind,target_id)=(NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id,NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (target_kind,target_id)=(NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id)
   AND (state<>'active' OR owner_user_id<>NEW.owner_user_id OR expires_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (source_kind,source_id)=(NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id))
 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (target_kind,target_id)=(NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id))>=16
 OR (NEW.source_kind='consumer' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_consumers WHERE origin_id=NEW.source_id
   AND actor_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND state='active' AND expires_at>=NEW.expires_at))
 OR (NEW.source_kind<>'consumer' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (target_kind,target_id)=(NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges WHERE (target_kind,target_id)=(NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id)
     AND (state<>'active' OR owner_user_id<>NEW.owner_user_id OR expires_at<NEW.expires_at))))
 OR (NEW.target_kind='content' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private_content WHERE content_id=NEW.target_id
   AND owner_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND kind IN('execution-consent','provider-response','context-proposal','chat-assistant')
   AND redacted_at IS NULL AND expires_at>=NEW.expires_at))
 OR (NEW.target_kind='event' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM event_private_payloads secret JOIN events event ON event.event_id=secret.private_event_id
   WHERE secret.private_event_id=NEW.target_id AND secret.owner_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND secret.redacted_at IS NULL
   AND event.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.owner_user_id AND event.type='AssistantReasoned'
   AND json_type(event.payload,'$.memory_origin_version')='integer' AND json_extract(event.payload,'$.memory_origin_version') IN(1,2,3)
   AND json_extract(event.payload,'$._private_ref')=event.event_id))
 OR EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(kind,id) AS(SELECT NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id UNION
   SELECT edge.source_kind,edge.source_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN ancestors
     ON (edge.target_kind,edge.target_id)=(ancestors.kind,ancestors.id) LIMIT 66)
   SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ancestors HAVING COUNT(*)>64 OR MAX(kind=NEW.target_kind AND id=NEW.target_id)=1)
 OR EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(kind,id) AS(SELECT NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id UNION
   SELECT edge.source_kind,edge.source_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN ancestors
     ON (edge.target_kind,edge.target_id)=(ancestors.kind,ancestors.id) LIMIT 66),
   descendants(root,kind,id) AS(SELECT id,kind,id FROM ancestors WHERE kind='consumer' UNION
     SELECT descendants.root,edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants
       ON (edge.source_kind,edge.source_id)=(descendants.kind,descendants.id) LIMIT 16449)
   SELECT root FROM descendants GROUP BY root HAVING COUNT(*)>=257)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_asset_source_unavailable'); END

BEGIN

 UPDATE private_content SET content='',redacted_at=COALESCE(redacted_at,NEW.retired_at)
  WHERE content_id IN(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(kind,id) AS(SELECT NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id UNION
 SELECT edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants
 ON (edge.source_kind,edge.source_id)=(descendants.kind,descendants.id)) SELECT id FROM descendants WHERE kind='content') AND redacted_at IS NULL;
 UPDATE event_private_payloads SET private_json='',redacted_at=COALESCE(redacted_at,NEW.retired_at)
  WHERE private_event_id IN(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(kind,id) AS(SELECT NEW.target_kind,NEW.target_id UNION
 SELECT edge.target_kind,edge.target_id FROM memory_derivation_asset_edges edge JOIN descendants
 ON (edge.source_kind,edge.source_id)=(descendants.kind,descendants.id)) SELECT id FROM descendants WHERE kind='event') AND redacted_at IS NULL;

    AND NEW.expires_at<=MIN(c.expires_at,r.expires_at) AND NEW.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')

    AND json_extract(p.content,'$.binding.request.memory.originId')=NEW.origin_id

 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_derivation_consumer_parents WHERE origin_id=NEW.origin_id)>=2
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_consumers child JOIN consequential_executions execution ON execution.execution_id=child.execution_id
  JOIN private_content approved ON approved.content_id=execution.consent_ref
  JOIN memory_derivation_consumers parent ON parent.origin_id=NEW.parent_origin_id
  JOIN consequential_executions prior ON prior.execution_id=parent.execution_id
  JOIN memory_derivation_consumer_contents registered ON registered.origin_id=parent.origin_id AND registered.role='result'
  JOIN private_content content ON content.content_id=registered.content_id,
  json_each(approved.content,'$.binding.request.memory.parents') expected
  WHERE child.origin_id=NEW.origin_id AND child.state='active' AND execution.status='quoted' AND parent.state='active'
   AND parent.actor_user_id=child.actor_user_id AND parent.scope_key=child.scope_key AND parent.turn_id<>child.turn_id
   AND parent.target_enrollment_id=child.target_enrollment_id AND parent.context_revision=child.context_revision
   AND parent.job_id=child.job_id AND parent.output_sha256=child.output_sha256
   AND parent.expires_at>=child.expires_at AND parent.created_at<=child.created_at
   AND prior.status='completed' AND prior.result_ref=NEW.parent_content_id AND registered.content_id=NEW.parent_content_id
   AND content.owner_id=parent.actor_user_id AND content.kind='context-proposal' AND content.redacted_at IS NULL
   AND content.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
   AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.originId')=parent.origin_id AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.turnId')=parent.turn_id
   AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.executionId')=parent.execution_id AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.contentId')=content.content_id
   AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.reply')=json_extract(content.content,'$.reply')
   AND json_extract(expected.value,'$.bindingHash')=prior.binding_hash
   AND json_extract(content.content,'$.sourceStatus')='semantic-memory-assisted')
 OR EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS(SELECT NEW.parent_origin_id UNION SELECT edge.parent_origin_id FROM memory_derivation_consumer_parents edge JOIN ancestors ON edge.origin_id=ancestors.id LIMIT 18)
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ancestors HAVING COUNT(*)>16 OR MAX(id=NEW.origin_id)=1)

 FROM consequential_executions execution JOIN private_content approved ON approved.content_id=execution.consent_ref,

 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance WHERE cost_id=OLD.reservation_id AND dispatch_token IS NULL AND admission_closed_at IS NULL)) OR (OLD.status='active' AND NEW.status='executing' AND NEW.used_microusd=0 AND NEW.settled_at IS NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance WHERE cost_id=OLD.reservation_id AND dispatch_token IS NULL AND admission_closed_at IS NULL)) OR (OLD.status IN('active','executing') AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND
 ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f JOIN memory_derivation_usage usage ON usage.finance_id=f.finance_id
 WHERE f.cost_id=OLD.reservation_id AND usage.used_microusd=NEW.used_microusd) AND NEW.status=CASE WHEN NEW.used_microusd=0 THEN 'released' ELSE 'settled' END)
 OR (NEW.status='released' AND NEW.used_microusd=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f
 JOIN memory_derivation_no_dispatch unused ON unused.finance_id=f.finance_id WHERE f.cost_id=OLD.reservation_id AND unused.cost_was_present=1))))))

objects.name: memory_derivation_finance
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_derivation_finance (
 finance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL ,
 payer_id TEXT NOT NULL ,
 period TEXT NOT NULL ,
 token_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE ,
 cost_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE ,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL ,
 provider TEXT NOT NULL , model TEXT NOT NULL ,
 terms_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL , request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL ,
 input_price INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 cached_input_price INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 output_price INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 maximum_input INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 maximum_output INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 maximum_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 maximum_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 authorized_cap_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL , project_access_id TEXT, pilot_cohort_id TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL , dispatch_token TEXT UNIQUE, dispatched_at TEXT, admission_closed_at TEXT,
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_1 CHECK(length(finance_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_2 CHECK(length(payer_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_3 CHECK(period=substr(created_at,1,7)),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_4 CHECK(length(token_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_5 CHECK(length(cost_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND cost_id<>token_id),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_6 CHECK(operation IN('memory-derivation:rolling-summary','memory-derivation:profile','memory-derivation:suggestion')),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_7 CHECK(provider='openai'),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_8 CHECK(length(model) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_9 CHECK(length(terms_sha256)=64 AND terms_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_10 CHECK(length(request_sha256)=64 AND request_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_11 CHECK(typeof(input_price)='integer' AND input_price BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_12 CHECK(typeof(cached_input_price)='integer' AND cached_input_price BETWEEN 0 AND input_price),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_13 CHECK(typeof(output_price)='integer' AND output_price BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_14 CHECK(typeof(maximum_input)='integer' AND maximum_input BETWEEN 1 AND 131072),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_15 CHECK(typeof(maximum_output)='integer' AND maximum_output BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_16 CHECK(typeof(maximum_tokens)='integer' AND maximum_tokens=maximum_input+maximum_output),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_17 CHECK(typeof(maximum_microusd)='integer' AND maximum_microusd BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000
   AND maximum_microusd=(maximum_input*input_price+maximum_output*output_price+999999)/1000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_18 CHECK(typeof(authorized_cap_microusd)='integer' AND authorized_cap_microusd BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_19 CHECK(length(workspace_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_20 CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_21 CHECK((workspace_id='forma' AND project_access_id IS NULL AND pilot_cohort_id IS NULL) OR (workspace_id<>'forma' AND project_access_id IS NOT NULL AND length(project_access_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240)),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_22 CHECK(pilot_cohort_id IS NULL OR length(pilot_cohort_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_23 CHECK((dispatch_token IS NULL AND dispatched_at IS NULL) OR (dispatch_token IS NOT NULL AND length(dispatch_token) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND length(dispatched_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',dispatched_at) IS dispatched_at AND dispatched_at>=created_at)),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_finance_check_24 CHECK(admission_closed_at IS NULL OR length(admission_closed_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',admission_closed_at) IS admission_closed_at AND admission_closed_at>=created_at)
)

objects.name: memory_derivation_finance_admit
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_finance_admit BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_finance
BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.dispatch_token IS NULL AND NEW.dispatched_at IS NULL AND NEW.admission_closed_at IS NULL
 AND NEW.period=strftime('%Y-%m','now') AND NEW.created_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.token_id,NEW.cost_id))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cost_budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.token_id,NEW.cost_id))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_budget_reservation_scopes WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.token_id,NEW.cost_id))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pilot_cost_reservation_scopes WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.token_id,NEW.cost_id))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_month_caps cap WHERE cap.payer_id=NEW.payer_id AND cap.period=NEW.period
   AND cap.cap_microusd<=NEW.authorized_cap_microusd
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_grants prior WHERE prior.actor_user_id=NEW.payer_id AND substr(prior.consented_at,1,7)=NEW.period AND prior.monthly_cap_microusd<cap.cap_microusd)
   AND NEW.maximum_microusd+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN unused.finance_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN usage.finance_id IS NOT NULL THEN usage.used_microusd ELSE existing.maximum_microusd END)
 FROM memory_derivation_finance existing LEFT JOIN memory_derivation_usage usage ON usage.finance_id=existing.finance_id
 LEFT JOIN memory_derivation_no_dispatch unused ON unused.finance_id=existing.finance_id WHERE existing.payer_id=NEW.payer_id AND existing.period=NEW.period),0)<=cap.cap_microusd)
 THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_admission_unavailable') END; END

objects.name: memory_derivation_finance_dispatch
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_finance_dispatch BEFORE UPDATE OF dispatch_token,dispatched_at ON memory_derivation_finance WHEN NEW.dispatch_token IS NOT OLD.dispatch_token OR NEW.dispatched_at IS NOT OLD.dispatched_at
BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.dispatch_token IS NULL AND OLD.dispatched_at IS NULL AND NEW.dispatch_token IS NOT NULL AND NEW.dispatched_at IS NOT NULL
 AND OLD.admission_closed_at IS NULL AND NEW.admission_closed_at IS NULL AND OLD.period=strftime('%Y-%m','now')
 AND NEW.dispatched_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_usage WHERE finance_id=OLD.finance_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_no_dispatch WHERE finance_id=OLD.finance_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_job_finance link JOIN memory_derivation_jobs job ON job.job_id=link.job_id
 JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=job.consent_id WHERE link.finance_id=OLD.finance_id AND job.state='leased'
 AND job.lease_expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.background_enabled=1 AND g.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f JOIN budget_reservations token ON token.reservation_id=f.token_id
 JOIN cost_budget_reservations cost ON cost.reservation_id=f.cost_id WHERE f.finance_id=OLD.finance_id
 AND (token.reservation_id=f.token_id AND token.owner_id=f.payer_id AND token.period=f.period AND token.operation=f.operation AND token.stream_id='memory-derivation:'||f.finance_id AND token.correlation_id=f.finance_id AND token.reserved_tokens=f.maximum_tokens) AND (cost.reservation_id=f.cost_id AND cost.owner_id=f.payer_id AND cost.period=f.period AND cost.operation=f.operation AND cost.stream_id='memory-derivation:'||f.finance_id AND cost.correlation_id=f.finance_id AND cost.reserved_microusd=f.maximum_microusd AND cost.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND cost.allow_user_overage=0) AND token.status='active' AND cost.status='executing'
 AND token.used_tokens=0 AND cost.used_microusd=0 AND token.settled_at IS NULL AND cost.settled_at IS NULL)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_month_caps cap WHERE cap.payer_id=NEW.payer_id AND cap.period=NEW.period
 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN unused.finance_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN usage.finance_id IS NOT NULL THEN usage.used_microusd ELSE existing.maximum_microusd END)
 FROM memory_derivation_finance existing LEFT JOIN memory_derivation_usage usage ON usage.finance_id=existing.finance_id
 LEFT JOIN memory_derivation_no_dispatch unused ON unused.finance_id=existing.finance_id WHERE existing.payer_id=NEW.payer_id AND existing.period=NEW.period),0)<=cap.cap_microusd)
 THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_dispatch_unavailable') END; END

objects.name: memory_derivation_grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_grants` (
	`consent_id` text NOT NULL,
	`grant_id` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`organization_id` text,
	`project_access_id` text,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`document_id` text NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`permission_epoch` text NOT NULL,
	`policy_version` text NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`qualification_id` text NOT NULL,
	`terms_sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`payer_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`monthly_cap_microusd` integer NOT NULL,
	`source_after_sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`retention_days` integer NOT NULL,
	`background_enabled` integer NOT NULL,
	`consented_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`revoked_at` text,
	PRIMARY KEY(`grant_id`, `revision`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`enrollment_id`) REFERENCES `memory_live_enrollments`(`enrollment_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`qualification_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_qualifications`(`qualification_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_scope" CHECK(length(actor_user_id)>0 AND length(owner_user_id)>0 AND length(project_id)>0 AND length(document_id)>0 AND payer_user_id=actor_user_id AND ((organization_id IS NULL AND project_access_id IS NULL AND actor_user_id=owner_user_id) OR (organization_id IS NOT NULL AND project_access_id IS NOT NULL AND length(organization_id)>0 AND length(project_access_id)>0))),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_identity" CHECK(length(consent_id)=36 AND length(grant_id)=64 AND grant_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(terms_sha256)=64 AND terms_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND policy_version='personal-memory-derivation-v1' AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion')),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_bounds" CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof(enrollment_revision)='integer' AND enrollment_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof(source_after_sequence)='integer' AND source_after_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740990 AND typeof(monthly_cap_microusd)='integer' AND monthly_cap_microusd BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000 AND typeof(retention_days)='integer' AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND background_enabled IN(0,1)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_time" CHECK(length(consented_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND consented_at<expires_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR length(revoked_at)=24 AND revoked_at>=consented_at))
)

 WHERE state IN('staging','active') AND job_id IN(
  SELECT d.job_id FROM memory_derivation_result_dependencies d JOIN memory_derivation_jobs j ON j.job_id=d.job_id
  JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=j.consent_id

  AND r.expires_at=NEW.expires_at AND r.published_at<=NEW.updated_at AND NEW.updated_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
  AND r.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))

 `expires_at` text,
 CONSTRAINT "memory_index_id" CHECK(length(job_id)=64 AND job_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CONSTRAINT "memory_index_state" CHECK((operation='upsert' AND generation=1 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (operation='delete' AND generation=2 AND expires_at IS NULL)),
 CONSTRAINT "memory_index_time" CHECK(length(updated_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',updated_at) IS updated_at AND (expires_at IS NULL OR length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND updated_at<expires_at))
)

objects.name: memory_derivation_job_finance_proof
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_job_finance_proof BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_job_finance
BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f JOIN memory_derivation_jobs job ON job.job_id=NEW.job_id
 JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=job.consent_id
 JOIN memory_derivation_qualifications q ON q.qualification_id=g.qualification_id
 JOIN memory_live_enrollments parent ON parent.enrollment_id=g.enrollment_id AND parent.revision=g.enrollment_revision
 WHERE f.finance_id=NEW.finance_id
 AND f.workspace_id=COALESCE(g.organization_id,'forma') AND f.project_access_id IS g.project_access_id
 AND f.provider=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.provider') AND f.model=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.model')
 AND f.input_price=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.pricing.inputMicroUsdPerMillion')
 AND f.cached_input_price=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.pricing.cachedInputMicroUsdPerMillion')
 AND f.output_price=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.pricing.outputMicroUsdPerMillion')
 AND f.maximum_input=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.maximumInputTokens') AND f.maximum_output=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.maximumOutputTokens')
 AND f.authorized_cap_microusd=json_extract(q.terms_json,'$.monthlyCapMicroUsd') AND q.terms_sha256=g.terms_sha256
 AND q.status='qualified' AND q.qualified_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND q.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND parent.learn_enabled=1 AND parent.background_enabled=1 AND parent.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND f.dispatch_token IS NULL AND f.admission_closed_at IS NULL
 AND f.payer_id=g.payer_user_id AND f.operation='memory-derivation:'||g.purpose AND f.terms_sha256=g.terms_sha256 AND f.authorized_cap_microusd=g.monthly_cap_microusd
 AND job.state='leased' AND job.lease_expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
 AND g.background_enabled=1 AND g.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
 THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_private_binding_unavailable') END; END

objects.name: memory_derivation_job_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_job_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_jobs WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_jobs WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id OR ((consent_id,after_sequence)=(NEW.consent_id,NEW.after_sequence)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_jobs p WHERE p.job_id=memory_derivation_jobs.job_id)
   =EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_jobs p WHERE p.job_id=NEW.job_id))) OR NEW.state!='waiting' OR NEW.attempts!=0 OR NEW.failure_code IS NOT NULL OR NEW.not_before!=NEW.created_at OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_cursors c JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON (g.grant_id,g.revision,g.consent_id)=(c.grant_id,c.grant_revision,c.consent_id) WHERE (c.consent_id,c.purpose)=(NEW.consent_id,NEW.purpose) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_jobs p JOIN memory_derivation_producer_cursors pc ON pc.consent_id=p.consent_id
 WHERE (p.job_id,p.consent_id,p.after_sequence,p.through_sequence)=(NEW.job_id,NEW.consent_id,NEW.after_sequence,NEW.through_sequence)
 AND pc.registered_through_sequence=p.after_sequence AND NEW.source_count=1)) OR
 (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_jobs WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id) AND (c.registered_through_sequence=NEW.after_sequence OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_split_commands split WHERE NEW.job_id IN(split.left_job_id,split.right_job_id)
 AND NEW.consent_id=json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[1]') AND NEW.purpose=json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[2]')
 AND NEW.after_sequence=CASE WHEN NEW.job_id=split.left_job_id THEN json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[3]') ELSE split.split_sequence END
 AND NEW.through_sequence=CASE WHEN NEW.job_id=split.left_job_id THEN split.split_sequence ELSE json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[4]') END
 AND NEW.created_at=json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[6]') AND NEW.expires_at=json_extract(split.parent_json,'$[7]')
 AND NEW.source_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(split.references_json) WHERE
  json_extract(value,'$[3]')>NEW.after_sequence AND json_extract(value,'$[3]')<=NEW.through_sequence))))) AND NEW.expires_at<=c.expires_at AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.background_enabled=1 AND g.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_derivation_job_insert'); END

objects.name: memory_derivation_jobs

CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_jobs` (
	`job_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`consent_id` text NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`after_sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`through_sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`source_count` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`lease_token` text,
	`lease_expires_at` text,
	`attempts` integer NOT NULL,
	`not_before` text NOT NULL,
	`failure_code` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`consent_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_cursors`(`consent_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_job_bounds" CHECK(length(job_id)=64 AND job_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(consent_id)=36 AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion') AND typeof(after_sequence)='integer' AND after_sequence>=0 AND typeof(through_sequence)='integer' AND through_sequence>after_sequence AND through_sequence<=9007199254740991 AND typeof(source_count)='integer' AND source_count BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(attempts)='integer' AND attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_job_lease" CHECK((state='waiting' AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL) OR (state='leased' AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND length(lease_token)=36 AND length(lease_expires_at)=24 AND lease_expires_at<=expires_at)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_job_time" CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND length(not_before)=24 AND created_at<expires_at AND not_before>=created_at AND (failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code IN('native-proof-unavailable','provider-unavailable','interrupted','budget-unavailable')))
)

WHEN NEW.compensates_event_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.type IN('BlockCreated','BlockRehomed','BlockRemoved','BlockRestored','DocumentCreated','DocumentForked','DocumentRemoved','DocumentRestored','DocumentRenderCompleted','DocumentArtifactEdited')
BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_results SET state='withdrawn',raw_json=NULL,manifest_json=NULL,output_sha256=NULL,manifest_sha256=NULL,retired_at=MAX(published_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE state IN('staging','active') AND job_id IN(
  SELECT d.job_id FROM memory_derivation_result_dependencies d JOIN events source ON source.event_id=d.resource_id
    WHERE d.kind='event' AND source.stream_id=NEW.stream_id AND (
      source.event_id=NEW.compensates_event_id
      OR NEW.type IN('BlockCreated','BlockRehomed','BlockRemoved','BlockRestored')
        AND json_extract(source.payload,'$.block_id')=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.block_id')
      OR NEW.type IN('DocumentRenderCompleted','DocumentArtifactEdited')
        AND json_extract(source.payload,'$.artifact_id')=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.artifact_id'))
  UNION SELECT j.job_id FROM memory_derivation_jobs j JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=j.consent_id
    WHERE NEW.type IN('DocumentCreated','DocumentForked','DocumentRemoved','DocumentRestored')
      AND NEW.stream_id='creative:'||g.owner_user_id AND json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.document_id')=g.document_id
); END

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_no_dispatch_proof BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_no_dispatch
BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f
 LEFT JOIN budget_reservations token ON token.reservation_id=f.token_id LEFT JOIN cost_budget_reservations cost ON cost.reservation_id=f.cost_id
 WHERE f.finance_id=NEW.finance_id AND f.admission_closed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.admission_closed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND NEW.recorded_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND f.dispatch_token IS NULL AND f.dispatched_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_usage WHERE finance_id=f.finance_id)
 AND NEW.token_was_present=(token.reservation_id IS NOT NULL) AND NEW.cost_was_present=(cost.reservation_id IS NOT NULL)
 AND (token.reservation_id IS NULL OR (token.reservation_id=f.token_id AND token.owner_id=f.payer_id AND token.period=f.period AND token.operation=f.operation AND token.stream_id='memory-derivation:'||f.finance_id AND token.correlation_id=f.finance_id AND token.reserved_tokens=f.maximum_tokens) AND token.status='active' AND token.used_tokens=0 AND token.settled_at IS NULL)
 AND (cost.reservation_id IS NULL OR (cost.reservation_id=f.cost_id AND cost.owner_id=f.payer_id AND cost.period=f.period AND cost.operation=f.operation AND cost.stream_id='memory-derivation:'||f.finance_id AND cost.correlation_id=f.finance_id AND cost.reserved_microusd=f.maximum_microusd AND cost.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND cost.allow_user_overage=0) AND cost.status IN('active','executing') AND cost.used_microusd=0 AND cost.settled_at IS NULL))
 THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_no_dispatch_unproven') END; END

CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_observation_controls` (
	`control_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`scope_key` text NOT NULL,
	`lineage_id` text NOT NULL,
	`claim_key` text NOT NULL,
	`source_event_ref` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`action` text NOT NULL,
	`correction_text` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enrollment_id`) REFERENCES `memory_live_enrollments`(`enrollment_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`source_event_ref`) REFERENCES `events`(`event_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_observation_control_shape" CHECK(length(control_id)=64 AND control_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(lineage_id)=64 AND lineage_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(actor_user_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length(scope_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND length(claim_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion') AND typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_observation_control_action" CHECK((action IN('suppressed','released') AND correction_text IS NULL) OR (action='corrected' AND correction_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(correction_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND length(CAST(correction_text AS BLOB))<=4096)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_observation_control_time" CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at AND length(updated_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',updated_at) IS updated_at AND length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND created_at<=updated_at AND updated_at<expires_at)
)

 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_grants WHERE consent_id=OLD.consent_id AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))

objects.name: memory_derivation_producer_cursor_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_producer_cursor_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_producer_cursors
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_cursors WHERE consent_id=NEW.consent_id) OR NEW.generation!=0
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_grants g WHERE g.consent_id=NEW.consent_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.background_enabled=1
  AND NEW.registered_through_sequence=g.source_after_sequence AND NEW.completed_through_sequence=g.source_after_sequence
  AND NEW.updated_at>=g.consented_at AND NEW.updated_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND NEW.updated_at<g.expires_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_producer_cursor_unavailable'); END

objects.name: memory_derivation_producer_cursor_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_producer_cursor_update BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_derivation_producer_cursors
WHEN NEW.consent_id IS NOT OLD.consent_id OR NEW.generation!=OLD.generation+1 OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at
 OR NEW.updated_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 OR NOT ((NEW.registered_through_sequence>OLD.registered_through_sequence AND NEW.completed_through_sequence=OLD.completed_through_sequence)
  OR (NEW.registered_through_sequence=OLD.registered_through_sequence AND NEW.completed_through_sequence>OLD.completed_through_sequence
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_producer_jobs p JOIN memory_derivation_jobs j ON j.job_id=p.job_id
    WHERE p.consent_id=NEW.consent_id AND p.after_sequence<NEW.completed_through_sequence
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_completions done WHERE done.job_id=j.job_id))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_producer_cursor_gap'); END

objects.name: memory_derivation_producer_cursors

CREATE TABLE memory_derivation_producer_cursors (
 consent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_derivation_cursors(consent_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 registered_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 completed_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK(typeof(registered_through_sequence)='integer' AND registered_through_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
 CHECK(typeof(completed_through_sequence)='integer' AND completed_through_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND registered_through_sequence),
 CHECK(typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
 CHECK(length(updated_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',updated_at) IS updated_at)
)

objects.name: memory_derivation_profile_context_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_profile_context_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_profile_contexts
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_derivation_profile_contexts WHERE target_enrollment_id=NEW.target_enrollment_id)>=2
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_profile_contexts WHERE target_enrollment_id=NEW.target_enrollment_id AND (job_id=NEW.job_id OR source_enrollment_id=NEW.source_enrollment_id))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_contexts c JOIN memory_live_enrollments e ON e.enrollment_id=NEW.source_enrollment_id
 JOIN memory_live_enrollments target ON target.enrollment_id=c.target_enrollment_id
 JOIN memory_derivation_jobs j ON j.job_id=NEW.job_id JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=j.consent_id
 JOIN memory_derivation_results r ON r.job_id=j.job_id
 WHERE c.target_enrollment_id=NEW.target_enrollment_id AND c.revision=NEW.context_revision AND c.state='accepted'
  AND c.source_enrollment_id<>NEW.source_enrollment_id AND c.job_id<>NEW.job_id AND c.actor_user_id=e.actor_user_id
  AND e.actor_user_id=target.actor_user_id AND e.organization_id IS target.organization_id
  AND e.revision=NEW.source_revision AND e.learn_enabled=1 AND e.recall_enabled=1
  AND g.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id AND g.enrollment_revision=e.revision AND g.purpose='profile' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
  AND r.state='active' AND r.output_sha256=NEW.output_sha256 AND NEW.expires_at=MIN(target.expires_at,r.expires_at)
  AND c.expires_at<=NEW.expires_at AND NEW.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_profile_context_unavailable'); END

objects.name: memory_derivation_profile_contexts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_derivation_profile_contexts (
 target_enrollment_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_derivation_contexts(target_enrollment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 context_revision text NOT NULL,
 job_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_derivation_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 output_sha256 text NOT NULL,
 source_enrollment_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_live_enrollments(enrollment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 source_revision integer NOT NULL,
 boundary_revision text,
 hierarchy_revision text,
 expires_at text NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(target_enrollment_id,job_id),
 UNIQUE(target_enrollment_id,source_enrollment_id),
 CONSTRAINT memory_profile_context_identity CHECK(length(context_revision)=36 AND length(output_sha256)=64 AND output_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CONSTRAINT memory_profile_context_revision CHECK(typeof(source_revision)='integer' AND source_revision>=1),
 CONSTRAINT memory_profile_context_expiry CHECK(length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at),
 CONSTRAINT memory_profile_context_range CHECK((target_enrollment_id=source_enrollment_id AND boundary_revision IS NULL AND hierarchy_revision IS NULL)
  OR (target_enrollment_id<>source_enrollment_id AND length(boundary_revision)=36 AND length(hierarchy_revision)=71))
)

CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_qualifications` (
	`qualification_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`source_sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`origin` text NOT NULL,
	`deployment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`terms_json` text NOT NULL,
	`terms_sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`qualified_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_qualification_hash" CHECK(length(source_sha256)=64 AND source_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(terms_sha256)=64 AND terms_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_qualification_terms" CHECK(json_valid(terms_json) AND json_type(terms_json)='object' AND length(CAST(terms_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_qualification_state" CHECK(status IN('qualified','withdrawn') AND length(qualified_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND qualified_at<expires_at)
)

	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`after_finance_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_finance`(`finance_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_recovery_singleton" CHECK("memory_derivation_recovery_cursor"."singleton"=1),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_recovery_generation" CHECK(typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_recovery_time" CHECK(length(updated_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',updated_at) IS updated_at)
)

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_result_update BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_derivation_results
WHEN NEW.job_id IS NOT OLD.job_id OR NEW.finance_id IS NOT OLD.finance_id OR NEW.dependency_count IS NOT OLD.dependency_count
 OR NEW.published_at IS NOT OLD.published_at OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at
 OR NOT ((OLD.state='staging' AND NEW.state='active' AND NEW.raw_json IS OLD.raw_json AND NEW.manifest_json IS OLD.manifest_json
  AND NEW.output_sha256 IS OLD.output_sha256 AND NEW.manifest_sha256 IS OLD.manifest_sha256 AND NEW.retired_at IS NULL
  AND NEW.dependency_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_derivation_result_dependencies WHERE job_id=OLD.job_id))
 OR (OLD.state IN('staging','active') AND NEW.state='withdrawn' AND NEW.raw_json IS NULL AND NEW.manifest_json IS NULL
  AND NEW.output_sha256 IS NULL AND NEW.manifest_sha256 IS NULL AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_result_cannot_rewrite'); END

objects.name: memory_derivation_results
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_results` (
	`job_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`finance_id` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`raw_json` text,
	`manifest_json` text,
	`output_sha256` text,
	`manifest_sha256` text,
	`dependency_count` integer NOT NULL,
	`published_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`retired_at` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`job_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_jobs`(`job_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`finance_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_finance`(`finance_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_result_state" CHECK(state IN('staging','active','withdrawn') AND typeof(dependency_count)='integer' AND dependency_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_result_body" CHECK((state IN('staging','active') AND raw_json IS NOT NULL AND manifest_json IS NOT NULL AND output_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(raw_json) AND json_valid(manifest_json) AND length(CAST(raw_json AS BLOB))<=65536 AND length(CAST(manifest_json AS BLOB))<=262144 AND length(output_sha256)=64 AND output_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(manifest_sha256)=64 AND manifest_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND retired_at IS NULL) OR (state='withdrawn' AND raw_json IS NULL AND manifest_json IS NULL AND output_sha256 IS NULL AND manifest_sha256 IS NULL AND retired_at IS NOT NULL)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_result_time" CHECK(length(published_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',published_at) IS published_at AND length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND published_at<expires_at AND (retired_at IS NULL OR length(retired_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',retired_at) IS retired_at AND retired_at>=published_at))
)

)

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_split_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_split_commands
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_split_commands)
 OR NEW.parent_json IS NOT (SELECT json_array(job_id,consent_id,purpose,after_sequence,through_sequence,source_count,created_at,expires_at,state,lease_token,lease_expires_at,attempts,not_before,failure_code) FROM memory_derivation_jobs WHERE job_id=NEW.parent_job_id)
 OR NEW.references_json IS NOT (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(job_id,enrollment_id,event_id,sequence,expires_at)) FROM (SELECT job_id,enrollment_id,event_id,sequence,expires_at FROM memory_derivation_job_sources WHERE job_id=NEW.parent_job_id ORDER BY sequence,event_id))
 OR json_array_length(NEW.references_json)!=json_extract(NEW.parent_json,'$[5]') OR json_extract(NEW.parent_json,'$[5]')<2
 OR NEW.split_sequence IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[3]') FROM json_each(NEW.references_json) WHERE key=CAST(json_extract(NEW.parent_json,'$[5]')/2 AS INTEGER)-1)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_jobs j JOIN memory_derivation_grants g ON g.consent_id=j.consent_id
  WHERE j.job_id=NEW.parent_job_id AND j.state='leased' AND j.lease_token=NEW.lease_token
  AND j.lease_expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') AND j.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
  AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.background_enabled=1
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_derivation_jobs pending WHERE pending.consent_id=j.consent_id
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_completions done WHERE done.job_id=pending.job_id))<160)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_job_finance WHERE job_id=NEW.parent_job_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance WHERE finance_id=NEW.finance_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.finance_id||':tokens',NEW.finance_id||':usd'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cost_budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id IN(NEW.finance_id||':tokens',NEW.finance_id||':usd'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_completions WHERE job_id=NEW.parent_job_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_results WHERE job_id=NEW.parent_job_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_jobs WHERE job_id IN(NEW.left_job_id,NEW.right_job_id))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_derivation_split_unavailable'); END

BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id=NEW.reservation_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f WHERE (NEW.reservation_id=f.token_id AND NEW.owner_id=f.payer_id AND NEW.period=f.period AND NEW.operation=f.operation AND NEW.stream_id='memory-derivation:'||f.finance_id AND NEW.correlation_id=f.finance_id AND NEW.reserved_tokens=f.maximum_tokens) AND f.dispatch_token IS NULL AND f.admission_closed_at IS NULL
 AND NEW.status='authorizing' AND NEW.used_tokens=0 AND NEW.settled_at IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_no_dispatch WHERE finance_id=f.finance_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_usage WHERE finance_id=f.finance_id))

 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance WHERE token_id=OLD.reservation_id AND dispatch_token IS NULL AND admission_closed_at IS NULL)) OR (OLD.status='active' AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND
 ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f JOIN memory_derivation_usage usage ON usage.finance_id=f.finance_id
 WHERE f.token_id=OLD.reservation_id AND usage.used_tokens=NEW.used_tokens) AND NEW.status=CASE WHEN NEW.used_tokens=0 THEN 'released' ELSE 'settled' END)
 OR (NEW.status='released' AND NEW.used_tokens=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f
 JOIN memory_derivation_no_dispatch unused ON unused.finance_id=f.finance_id WHERE f.token_id=OLD.reservation_id AND unused.token_was_present=1))))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_hold_retained'); END

CREATE TABLE memory_derivation_usage (
 finance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_derivation_finance(finance_id),
 provider_request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE ,
 receipt_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL ,
 input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 cached_input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 used_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 used_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL ,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_1 CHECK(length(provider_request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_2 CHECK(length(receipt_sha256)=64 AND receipt_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_3 CHECK(typeof(input_tokens)='integer' AND input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_4 CHECK(typeof(cached_input_tokens)='integer' AND cached_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND input_tokens),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_5 CHECK(typeof(output_tokens)='integer' AND output_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_6 CHECK(typeof(used_tokens)='integer' AND used_tokens=input_tokens+output_tokens),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_7 CHECK(typeof(used_microusd)='integer' AND used_microusd BETWEEN 0 AND 2000000000),
 CONSTRAINT memory_derivation_usage_check_8 CHECK(length(recorded_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',recorded_at) IS recorded_at)
)

CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_usage_proof BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_usage
BEGIN 
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_finance f WHERE f.finance_id=NEW.finance_id
 AND f.dispatch_token IS NOT NULL AND f.dispatched_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND NEW.recorded_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_no_dispatch WHERE finance_id=f.finance_id)
 AND NEW.used_microusd=((NEW.input_tokens-NEW.cached_input_tokens)*f.input_price+NEW.cached_input_tokens*f.cached_input_price+NEW.output_tokens*f.output_price+999999)/1000000)
 THEN 1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'memory_finance_usage_unverified') END; END

objects.name: memory_derivation_user_controls
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_user_controls` (
	`control_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`scope_key` text NOT NULL,
	`lineage_id` text NOT NULL,
	`claim_key` text NOT NULL,
	`source_content_ref` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`action` text NOT NULL,
	`correction_text` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enrollment_id`) REFERENCES `memory_live_enrollments`(`enrollment_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`source_content_ref`) REFERENCES `private_content`(`content_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_user_control_shape" CHECK(length(control_id)=64 AND control_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(lineage_id)=64 AND lineage_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(actor_user_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length(scope_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 AND length(claim_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion') AND typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_user_control_action" CHECK((action IN('suppressed','released') AND correction_text IS NULL) OR (action='corrected' AND correction_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(correction_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND length(CAST(correction_text AS BLOB))<=4096)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_user_control_time" CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at AND length(updated_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',updated_at) IS updated_at AND length(expires_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND created_at<=updated_at AND updated_at<expires_at)
)

CREATE TABLE `memory_recall_boundaries` (
	`enrollment_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`boundary` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` text NOT NULL,
	`consented_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enrollment_id`) REFERENCES `memory_live_enrollments`(`enrollment_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_recall_boundary_kind" CHECK(boundary IN('document','project','project-tree','partition')),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_recall_boundary_parent" CHECK(typeof(enrollment_revision)='integer' AND enrollment_revision>=1),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_recall_boundary_revision" CHECK(length(revision)=36),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_recall_boundary_time" CHECK(length(consented_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',consented_at) IS consented_at)
)

 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_contexts c JOIN consequential_executions e ON e.execution_id=NEW.execution_id
  WHERE c.context_id=NEW.context_id AND c.actor_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND c.state='active' AND c.snapshot_sha256=NEW.snapshot_sha256 AND json_extract(c.snapshot_json,'$.resourceKey')=NEW.resource_key
   AND e.actor_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND e.operation='assistant-specialist' AND e.status='quoted'
   AND NEW.state='active' AND NEW.expires_at<=c.expires_at AND NEW.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))

 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1),
 learn_enabled integer NOT NULL CHECK(learn_enabled IN(0,1)),
 recall_enabled integer NOT NULL CHECK(recall_enabled IN(0,1)),

 retention_days integer NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(retention_days)='integer' AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
 time_zone text NOT NULL,

 next_due_at text NOT NULL CHECK(length(next_due_at)=24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',next_due_at) IS next_due_at),
 last_local_day text,

 CHECK(resource_kind<>'library' OR resource_id=project_id),

)

objects.name: organization_project_nesting_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER organization_project_nesting_insert AFTER INSERT ON organization_project_nesting BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_project_nesting WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id)>256 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_capacity') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_containment WHERE owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND parent_project_id IS NOT NULL) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_duplicate_parent') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events c JOIN events p ON p.event_id=NEW.parent_declaration_ref
  WHERE c.event_id=NEW.declaration_ref AND c.type='ProjectCreated' AND c.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.owner_user_id AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.project_id')=NEW.project_id
  AND p.type='ProjectCreated' AND p.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.parent_owner_user_id AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.project_id')=NEW.parent_project_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE compensates_event_id IN(NEW.declaration_ref,NEW.parent_declaration_ref)) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_declaration') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_projects c JOIN organization_projects p ON p.organization_id=c.organization_id
  JOIN project_migration_states cm ON cm.project_access_id=c.project_access_id AND cm.organization_id=c.organization_id AND cm.owner_user_id=c.owner_user_id AND cm.status='active'
  JOIN project_migration_states pm ON pm.project_access_id=p.project_access_id AND pm.organization_id=p.organization_id AND pm.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id AND pm.status='active'
  WHERE c.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND c.project_id=NEW.project_id AND c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.status='active'
  AND p.owner_user_id=NEW.parent_owner_user_id AND p.project_id=NEW.parent_project_id AND p.status='active') THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_custody') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE edges(owner,id,parent_owner,parent_id) AS (
 SELECT owner_user_id,project_id,owner_user_id,parent_project_id FROM project_containment WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND parent_project_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,project_id,parent_owner_user_id,parent_project_id FROM organization_project_nesting WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id),
 ancestry(owner,id,parent_owner,parent_id,depth) AS (
 SELECT owner,id,parent_owner,parent_id,1 FROM edges
 UNION ALL SELECT e.owner,e.id,e.parent_owner,e.parent_id,a.depth+1 FROM ancestry a JOIN edges e ON e.owner=a.parent_owner AND e.id=a.parent_id WHERE a.depth<16)
 SELECT 1 FROM ancestry WHERE depth=16) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_cycle_or_depth') END;
 UPDATE memory_derivation_contexts SET state='dismissed' WHERE state='accepted' AND source_enrollment_id<>target_enrollment_id AND source_enrollment_id IN(SELECT enrollment_id FROM memory_live_enrollments WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id);
END

objects.name: organization_project_nesting_local_delete
organization_project_nesting_local_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER organization_project_nesting_local_insert AFTER INSERT ON project_containment BEGIN
 DELETE FROM organization_project_nesting WHERE owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE edges(owner,id,parent_owner,parent_id) AS (
 SELECT owner_user_id,project_id,owner_user_id,parent_project_id FROM project_containment WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND parent_project_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT owner_user_id,project_id,parent_owner_user_id,parent_project_id FROM organization_project_nesting WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id),
 ancestry(owner,id,parent_owner,parent_id,depth) AS (

 SELECT 1 FROM ancestry WHERE depth=16) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'organization_nesting_cycle_or_depth') END;

 END

objects.name: project_containment_declaration_update
project_containment_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER project_containment_insert AFTER INSERT ON project_containment BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_containment WHERE owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id)>256 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'project_containment_capacity') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(project_id,parent_id,depth) AS (
   SELECT project_id,parent_project_id,1 FROM project_containment WHERE owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id
   UNION ALL SELECT parent.project_id,parent.parent_project_id,ancestry.depth+1
     FROM ancestry JOIN project_containment parent ON parent.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND parent.project_id=ancestry.parent_id WHERE ancestry.depth<16
 ) SELECT 1 FROM ancestry WHERE depth=16 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'project_containment_cycle_or_depth') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events child WHERE child.event_id=NEW.declaration_ref AND child.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.owner_user_id
   AND child.type='ProjectCreated' AND json_extract(child.payload,'$.project_id')=NEW.project_id)
   OR NEW.parent_project_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events parent WHERE parent.event_id=NEW.parent_declaration_ref
   AND parent.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.owner_user_id AND parent.type='ProjectCreated' AND json_extract(parent.payload,'$.project_id')=NEW.parent_project_id)
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'project_containment_declaration') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events compensation WHERE compensation.stream_id='creative:'||NEW.owner_user_id
   AND compensation.compensates_event_id IN(NEW.declaration_ref,NEW.parent_declaration_ref)) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'project_containment_compensated') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.organization_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_projects p WHERE p.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id
   AND p.project_id IN(NEW.project_id,NEW.parent_project_id)) OR NEW.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND (
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_projects p WHERE p.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id AND p.project_id=NEW.project_id AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.status='active')
   OR NEW.parent_project_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_projects p WHERE p.owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id
     AND p.project_id=NEW.parent_project_id AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.status='active'))
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'project_containment_custody') END;
END

memory_derivation_grants.name: memory_derivation_grants
memory_derivation_grants.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_grants` (
	`consent_id` text NOT NULL,
	`grant_id` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`organization_id` text,
	`project_access_id` text,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`document_id` text NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`permission_epoch` text NOT NULL,
	`policy_version` text NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`qualification_id` text NOT NULL,
	`terms_sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`payer_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`monthly_cap_microusd` integer NOT NULL,
	`source_after_sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`retention_days` integer NOT NULL,
	`background_enabled` integer NOT NULL,
	`consented_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`revoked_at` text,
	PRIMARY KEY(`grant_id`, `revision`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`enrollment_id`) REFERENCES `memory_live_enrollments`(`enrollment_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`qualification_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_qualifications`(`qualification_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_scope" CHECK(length(actor_user_id)>0 AND length(owner_user_id)>0 AND length(project_id)>0 AND length(document_id)>0 AND payer_user_id=actor_user_id AND ((organization_id IS NULL AND project_access_id IS NULL AND actor_user_id=owner_user_id) OR (organization_id IS NOT NULL AND project_access_id IS NOT NULL AND length(organization_id)>0 AND length(project_access_id)>0))),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_identity" CHECK(length(consent_id)=36 AND length(grant_id)=64 AND grant_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length(terms_sha256)=64 AND terms_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND policy_version='personal-memory-derivation-v1' AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion')),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_bounds" CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof(enrollment_revision)='integer' AND enrollment_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof(source_after_sequence)='integer' AND source_after_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740990 AND typeof(monthly_cap_microusd)='integer' AND monthly_cap_microusd BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000 AND typeof(retention_days)='integer' AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND background_enabled IN(0,1)),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_grant_time" CHECK(length(consented_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND consented_at<expires_at AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR length(revoked_at)=24 AND revoked_at>=consented_at))
)

idx_memory_derivation_grant_active.name: idx_memory_derivation_grant_active

	`terms_sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_qualification_terms" CHECK(json_valid(terms_json) AND json_type(terms_json)='object' AND length(CAST(terms_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_qualification_state" CHECK(status IN('qualified','withdrawn') AND length(qualified_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND qualified_at<expires_at)
)

memory_derivation_grant_immutable.name: memory_derivation_grant_immutable
memory_derivation_grant_immutable.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_grant_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_derivation_grants WHEN OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.revoked_at IS NULL OR OLD.consent_id IS NOT NEW.consent_id OR OLD.grant_id IS NOT NEW.grant_id OR OLD.revision IS NOT NEW.revision OR OLD.actor_user_id IS NOT NEW.actor_user_id OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id OR OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.project_access_id IS NOT NEW.project_access_id OR OLD.project_id IS NOT NEW.project_id OR OLD.document_id IS NOT NEW.document_id OR OLD.enrollment_id IS NOT NEW.enrollment_id OR OLD.enrollment_revision IS NOT NEW.enrollment_revision OR OLD.permission_epoch IS NOT NEW.permission_epoch OR OLD.policy_version IS NOT NEW.policy_version OR OLD.purpose IS NOT NEW.purpose OR OLD.qualification_id IS NOT NEW.qualification_id OR OLD.terms_sha256 IS NOT NEW.terms_sha256 OR OLD.payer_user_id IS NOT NEW.payer_user_id OR OLD.monthly_cap_microusd IS NOT NEW.monthly_cap_microusd OR OLD.source_after_sequence IS NOT NEW.source_after_sequence OR OLD.retention_days IS NOT NEW.retention_days OR OLD.background_enabled IS NOT NEW.background_enabled OR OLD.consented_at IS NOT NEW.consented_at OR OLD.expires_at IS NOT NEW.expires_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_derivation_grant_immutable'); END

memory_derivation_grant_parent_changed.name: memory_derivation_grant_parent_changed
memory_derivation_grant_parent_changed.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_grant_parent_changed AFTER UPDATE OF actor_user_id,owner_user_id,organization_id,project_access_id,project_id,document_id,permission_epoch,policy_version,revision,learn_enabled,recall_enabled,background_enabled,retention_days,enrolled_at,expires_at ON memory_live_enrollments WHEN OLD.actor_user_id IS NOT NEW.actor_user_id OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id OR OLD.organization_id IS NOT NEW.organization_id OR OLD.project_access_id IS NOT NEW.project_access_id OR OLD.project_id IS NOT NEW.project_id OR OLD.document_id IS NOT NEW.document_id OR OLD.permission_epoch IS NOT NEW.permission_epoch OR OLD.policy_version IS NOT NEW.policy_version OR OLD.revision IS NOT NEW.revision OR OLD.learn_enabled IS NOT NEW.learn_enabled OR OLD.recall_enabled IS NOT NEW.recall_enabled OR OLD.background_enabled IS NOT NEW.background_enabled OR OLD.retention_days IS NOT NEW.retention_days OR OLD.enrolled_at IS NOT NEW.enrolled_at OR OLD.expires_at IS NOT NEW.expires_at BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_grants SET revoked_at=MAX(consented_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE enrollment_id=OLD.enrollment_id AND revoked_at IS NULL; END

memory_derivation_grant_qualification_wi.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_grant_qualification_withdrawn AFTER UPDATE OF status ON memory_derivation_qualifications WHEN NEW.status='withdrawn' BEGIN UPDATE memory_derivation_grants SET revoked_at=MAX(consented_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE qualification_id=OLD.qualification_id AND revoked_at IS NULL; END

memory_derivation_qualification_no_repla.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_qualification_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_qualifications WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_qualifications WHERE qualification_id=NEW.qualification_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_derivation_qualification_no_replace'); END

memory_derivation_grant_no_replace.name: memory_derivation_grant_no_replace
memory_derivation_grant_no_replace.sql: CREATE TRIGGER memory_derivation_grant_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON memory_derivation_grants WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_derivation_grants WHERE grant_id=NEW.grant_id AND (revision=NEW.revision OR revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_derivation_grant_no_replace'); END

memory_derivation_cursors.name: memory_derivation_cursors
memory_derivation_cursors.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_cursors` (
	`consent_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`grant_id` text NOT NULL,
	`grant_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`purpose` text NOT NULL,
	`registered_through_sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`generation` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`grant_id`,`grant_revision`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_grants`(`grant_id`,`revision`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_cursor_bounds" CHECK(length(consent_id)=36 AND purpose IN('rolling-summary','profile','suggestion') AND typeof(grant_revision)='integer' AND grant_revision>0 AND typeof(registered_through_sequence)='integer' AND registered_through_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_derivation_cursor_time" CHECK(length(created_at)=24 AND length(updated_at)=24 AND length(expires_at)=24 AND created_at<=updated_at AND updated_at<expires_at)
)

memory_derivation_job_sources.name: memory_derivation_job_sources
memory_derivation_job_sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_derivation_job_sources` (
	`job_id` text NOT NULL,
	`enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`event_id` text NOT NULL,
	`sequence` integer NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`job_id`, `event_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`job_id`) REFERENCES `memory_derivation_jobs`(`job_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
