 actor_user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 context_id text NOT NULL CHECK(length(context_id)=36),
 resource_key text NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(resource_key) AND json_array_length(resource_key)=7 AND json_extract(resource_key,'$[0]')='memory-resource-v1'),
 snapshot_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(length(snapshot_sha256)=64 AND snapshot_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'),
 state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('active','retired')),
 created_at text NOT NULL CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at),
 expires_at text NOT NULL CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND expires_at>created_at),
 retired_at text,
 CHECK((state='active' AND retired_at IS NULL) OR (state='retired' AND retired_at>=created_at))
)

 role text NOT NULL CHECK(role IN('consent','response','result')),

)

memory_resource_assistant_run_insert.name: memory_resource_assistant_run_insert
memory_resource_assistant_run_insert.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_resource_assistant_run_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_resource_assistant_runs
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_assistant_runs WHERE execution_id=NEW.execution_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_contexts c JOIN consequential_executions e ON e.execution_id=NEW.execution_id
  WHERE c.context_id=NEW.context_id AND c.actor_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND c.state='active' AND c.snapshot_sha256=NEW.snapshot_sha256 AND json_extract(c.snapshot_json,'$.resourceKey')=NEW.resource_key
   AND e.actor_user_id=NEW.actor_user_id AND e.operation='assistant-specialist' AND e.status='quoted'
   AND NEW.state='active' AND NEW.expires_at<=c.expires_at AND NEW.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'resource_assistant_origin_required'); END

memory_resource_assistant_run_immutable.name: memory_resource_assistant_run_immutable
memory_resource_assistant_run_immutable.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_resource_assistant_run_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_resource_assistant_runs
WHEN OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'retired'
 OR (NEW.execution_id,NEW.actor_user_id,NEW.context_id,NEW.resource_key,NEW.snapshot_sha256,NEW.created_at,NEW.expires_at)
 IS NOT (OLD.execution_id,OLD.actor_user_id,OLD.context_id,OLD.resource_key,OLD.snapshot_sha256,OLD.created_at,OLD.expires_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'resource_assistant_origin_immutable'); END

memory_resource_assistant_content_insert.name: memory_resource_assistant_content_insert

CREATE TRIGGER memory_resource_assistant_content_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_resource_assistant_contents

 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_assistant_runs run JOIN private_content content ON content.content_id=NEW.content_id
  JOIN memory_resource_contexts context ON context.context_id=run.context_id
  WHERE run.execution_id=NEW.execution_id AND run.state='active' AND run.expires_at>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')
   AND context.state='active' AND context.actor_user_id=run.actor_user_id AND context.snapshot_sha256=run.snapshot_sha256
   AND content.owner_id=run.actor_user_id AND content.redacted_at IS NULL AND content.expires_at<=run.expires_at
   AND content.kind=CASE NEW.role WHEN 'consent' THEN 'execution-consent' WHEN 'response' THEN 'provider-response' WHEN 'result' THEN 'context-proposal' END)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'resource_assistant_private_content_required'); END

memory_resource_assistant_content_restor.name: memory_resource_assistant_content_restore
memory_resource_assistant_content_restor.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_resource_assistant_content_restore BEFORE UPDATE ON private_content
WHEN NEW.redacted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_assistant_contents link JOIN memory_resource_assistant_runs run ON run.execution_id=link.execution_id
 WHERE link.content_id=NEW.content_id AND (run.state<>'active' OR run.expires_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'resource_assistant_content_retired'); END

memory_resource_assistant_content_reinse.name: memory_resource_assistant_content_reinsert
memory_resource_assistant_content_reinse.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_resource_assistant_content_reinsert BEFORE INSERT ON private_content
WHEN NEW.redacted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_resource_assistant_contents link JOIN memory_resource_assistant_runs run ON run.execution_id=link.execution_id
 WHERE link.content_id=NEW.content_id AND (run.state<>'active' OR run.expires_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'resource_assistant_content_retired'); END

memory_scope_profile_checkpoints.name: memory_scope_profile_checkpoints
memory_scope_profile_checkpoints.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_scope_profile_checkpoints` (
	`target_enrollment_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`target_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`checked_at` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_revision" CHECK(typeof(target_revision)='integer' AND target_revision>0),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_time" CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',checked_at) IS checked_at),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_status" CHECK(status IN('stored','unchanged','unavailable'))
)

memory_scope_profile_snapshots.name: memory_scope_profile_snapshots
memory_scope_profile_snapshots.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_scope_profile_snapshots` (
	`profile_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`actor_user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`target_enrollment_id` text NOT NULL,
	`target_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`manifest_json` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_hash" CHECK(length(profile_id)=64 AND profile_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_revision" CHECK(typeof(target_revision)='integer' AND target_revision>0),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_manifest" CHECK(json_valid(manifest_json) AND json_type(manifest_json)='object' AND length(CAST(manifest_json AS BLOB))<=65536),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_created" CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_scope_profile_expiry" CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',expires_at) IS expires_at AND expires_at>created_at)
)

memory_scope_profile_snapshot_immutable.name: memory_scope_profile_snapshot_immutable
memory_scope_profile_snapshot_immutable.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_scope_profile_snapshot_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_scope_profile_snapshots
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scope_profile_immutable'); END

memory_scope_profile_snapshot_no_replace.name: memory_scope_profile_snapshot_no_replace
memory_scope_profile_snapshot_no_replace.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_scope_profile_snapshot_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON memory_scope_profile_snapshots
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_scope_profile_snapshots WHERE profile_id=NEW.profile_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scope_profile_cannot_replace'); END

memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_identity.name: memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_identity
memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_identity.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_scope_profile_checkpoint_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_scope_profile_checkpoints
WHEN NEW.target_enrollment_id IS NOT OLD.target_enrollment_id OR NEW.actor_user_id IS NOT OLD.actor_user_id OR NEW.checked_at<OLD.checked_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scope_profile_checkpoint_identity'); END

memory_authored_image_receipts.name: memory_authored_image_receipts
memory_authored_image_receipts.sql:
CREATE TABLE `memory_authored_image_receipts` (
	`content_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`event_id` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_id` text NOT NULL,
	`media_key` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`retired_at` text,
	CONSTRAINT "memory_authored_image_state" CHECK(state IN('active','retired')),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_authored_image_created" CHECK(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',created_at) IS created_at),
	CONSTRAINT "memory_authored_image_retirement" CHECK((state='active' AND retired_at IS NULL) OR (state='retired' AND retired_at>=created_at))
)

memory_authored_image_receipt_insert.name: memory_authored_image_receipt_insert
memory_authored_image_receipt_insert.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_receipt_insert BEFORE INSERT ON memory_authored_image_receipts
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts WHERE content_id=NEW.content_id OR event_id=NEW.event_id OR media_key=NEW.media_key)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private_content c JOIN event_private_payloads p ON p.owner_id=c.owner_id AND p.private_event_id=NEW.event_id
 JOIN events e ON e.event_id=p.private_event_id AND e.stream_id='creative:'||c.owner_id
 WHERE c.content_id=NEW.content_id AND c.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND c.kind='authored-memory-image' AND c.redacted_at IS NULL AND p.redacted_at IS NULL
 AND json_extract(p.private_json,'$.output_ref')=c.content_id AND json_extract(c.content,'$.key')=NEW.media_key
 AND e.type='GenerationCompleted' AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.memory_image_acceptance_version')=1 AND NEW.state='active')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_acceptance_required'); END

memory_authored_image_receipt_update.name: memory_authored_image_receipt_update
memory_authored_image_receipt_update.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_receipt_update BEFORE UPDATE ON memory_authored_image_receipts
WHEN OLD.state<>'active' OR NEW.state<>'retired'
 OR (NEW.content_id,NEW.event_id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.media_key,NEW.created_at) IS NOT (OLD.content_id,OLD.event_id,OLD.owner_id,OLD.media_key,OLD.created_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_receipt_immutable'); END

memory_authored_image_receipt_delete.name: memory_authored_image_receipt_delete
memory_authored_image_receipt_delete.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_receipt_delete BEFORE DELETE ON memory_authored_image_receipts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_tombstone_required'); END

memory_authored_image_body_update.name: memory_authored_image_body_update
memory_authored_image_body_update.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_body_update BEFORE UPDATE ON private_content
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts r WHERE r.content_id=OLD.content_id)
 AND NEW.redacted_at IS NULL AND (OLD.redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.owner_id IS NOT OLD.owner_id OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind
 OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR json_remove(NEW.content,'$.projected') IS NOT json_remove(OLD.content,'$.projected')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts r WHERE r.content_id=OLD.content_id AND r.state<>'active'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_body_immutable'); END

memory_authored_image_body_insert.name: memory_authored_image_body_insert
memory_authored_image_body_insert.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_body_insert BEFORE INSERT ON private_content
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM memory_authored_image_receipts r WHERE r.content_id=NEW.content_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'memory_authored_image_restore_denied'); END

memory_authored_image_body_retire.name: memory_authored_image_body_retire
memory_authored_image_body_retire.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_body_retire AFTER UPDATE ON private_content
WHEN NEW.redacted_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN UPDATE memory_authored_image_receipts SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE content_id=OLD.content_id AND state='active'; END

memory_authored_image_body_delete.name: memory_authored_image_body_delete
memory_authored_image_body_delete.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_body_delete BEFORE DELETE ON private_content
BEGIN UPDATE memory_authored_image_receipts SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE content_id=OLD.content_id AND state='active'; END

memory_authored_image_event_retire.name: memory_authored_image_event_retire
memory_authored_image_event_retire.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_event_retire AFTER UPDATE ON event_private_payloads
WHEN NEW.redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.private_json IS NOT OLD.private_json OR NEW.owner_id IS NOT OLD.owner_id
BEGIN UPDATE memory_authored_image_receipts SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE event_id=OLD.private_event_id AND state='active'; END

memory_authored_image_event_delete.name: memory_authored_image_event_delete
memory_authored_image_event_delete.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER memory_authored_image_event_delete BEFORE DELETE ON event_private_payloads
BEGIN UPDATE memory_authored_image_receipts SET state='retired',retired_at=MAX(created_at,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE event_id=OLD.private_event_id AND state='active'; END
